violations.title: Jewelry
violations.observation: Food employee observed wearing jewelry on their arms and hands (gold bracelet) while preparing food.
violations.corrective_action: Food employees shall limit their jewelry to a plain wedding ring while preparing food. Food employees may not wear bracelets, watches, etc. because they can inhibit proper hand washing. CDI: CFM instructed food employee to remove bracelet and wash hands before returning to food preparation.

out_items.name: Adequate ventilation and lighting, designated areas used

violations.title: -Designated Areas for Eating/Drinking/Smoking
violations.observation: Observed that the area designated for employees drink containers is not located to protect dry food items from contamination in dry storage area. Observed employee drinks stored mixed in with dry storage food items on the dry storage shelf in back of the main kitchen.
violations.corrective_action: Relocate the area designated to accommodate employees' personal needs to prevent the potential contamination of food, food equipment and utensils, linens, or single-service items. CDI: CFM relocated employee drinks to designated area away from dry storage food items.

out_items.name: Procedures for responding to vomiting and diarrheal events

violations.title: Clean-up of vomiting and diarrheal events
violations.observation: The food establishment does not have written procedures for employees to follow when responding to vomiting or diarrheal events.
violations.corrective_action: A food establishment shall have written procedures for employees to follow when responding to vomiting or diarrheal events that involve the discharge of vomitus or fecal matter onto surfaces in the food establishment. The procedures shall address the specific actions employees must take to minimize the spread of contamination and the exposure of employees, consumers, food and surfaces to vomitus or fecal matter. CDI: EHS emailed CFM written procedures for responding to vomiting or diarrheal events.

violations.title: Proper thawing methods used for TCS Foods
violations.observation: Observed the following food thawing using an improper method: Observed 2 bags of commercially prepared chicken strips (77F) improperly thawing on top of conveyor belt oven at sandwich prep station for 15 mins.
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature control for safety food shall be thawed using one of the following methods: 1) under refrigeration that maintains the food temperature at 41F or less, 2) completely submerged under running water at a water temperature of 70F or below with a sufficient velocity to agitate and float off loose particles of food as long as held for period of time at a temperature of 41F or less, or 3) as part of a cooking process if the food is cooked as specified by Law or thawed in a microwave oven and immediately transferred to a conventional cooking process. CDI: CFM reheated the chicken strips in oven for hot holding.

out_items.name: Insects, rodents, and animals not present

violations.title: Insect Control Devices, Installation
violations.observation: Observed insect control device (insect lamp) located directly over food prep area/ beverage stored in cambro in kitchen area where dead insects may be impelled or fall.
violations.corrective_action: Relocate the insect control device so that it is not located over a food preparation area and dead insects are prevented from being falling on exposed food, clean equipment, utensils, linens, and unwrapped single-service and single-use articles. CDI: CFM relocated beverage and designated to not use prep area to prepare food.
